title: Course Schedule
constraints: All the pairs [ai, bi] are unique.
description:
There are a total of `numCourses` courses you have to take, labeled from `0` to `numCourses - 1`. You are given an array `prerequisites` where `prerequisites[i] = [a, b]` indicates that you **must** take course `b` first if you want to take course `a`.

Return `true` if you can finish all courses. Otherwise, return `false`.

A cycle in the prerequisite graph means it is **impossible** to complete all courses.

```text
numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1, 0]]

  0 ---> 1   (take 0, then 1)

No cycle -> true

numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]

  0 ---> 1
  1 ---> 0   (cycle!)

Cycle detected -> false
```

tests.explanation: Take course 0 first, then course 1. No cycle.
Course 0 requires course 1, and course 1 requires course 0 -- a cycle exists.
